economic_implementation.abstention_accounting: Every evaluated condition contributes zero PnL when its model abstains or receives no fill.
economic_implementation.book_residency: A caller-supplied batch factory is replayed once per model so recorded books remain bounded in memory and are never duplicated on disk.
economic_implementation.execution_identity: Base and augmented probabilities are evaluated through the frozen Round 27 fee, depth, FOK, latency, outcome, and confidence implementation.
economic_implementation.matched_population: The Round 28 partition is projected to Round 27 only after exact sample, feature-row, offset, target, weight, and condition identity checks.
economic_implementation.promotion: Every fixed delay requires the augmented Round 27 scenario gate, strictly greater after-cost net PnL, positive paired mean and stationary-bootstrap lower bound, and no worse maximum drawdown.
economic_implementation.sealed_policy: Selection economics cannot access the sealed role and cannot grant paper or live order authority.
